xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DisclosureOfNotesOnFinancialRe:
1 These consolidated financial results have been prepared in accordance with the Indian Accounting Standards (IND AS) as notified by Ministry of Corporate Affairs pursuant to Section 133 of the Companies Act 2013 read with the Companies (Indian Accounting Standard) Rules, 2015, as amended and in terms of regulation 33 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 and other accounting principles generally accepted in India.
2 Details of Exceptional Items for the previous year:
(a) : With effect from November 21, 2025, the Government of India has brought the four Labour Codes into force. The Group had evaluated impact of the Labour Codes on its employee benefit obligations, and an additional liability of Rs 286.20 lakhs had been accounted for and disclosed as an exceptional item in the previous year ended March 31, 2026 in line with the principles outlined by the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India.
(b) : During the previous year, on 21st May-2025 a significant fire incident had occurred at the manufacturing plant of the Subsidiary Company located at Nashik, Maharashtra, resulting in damage of property, plant & equipment, capital work in progress and inventories. The Subsidiary Company had engaged internal and external experts to assess loss due to fire and has accordingly wrriten off property plant and equipment, capital work in progress, inventories and Goods and Service Tax thereon aggregating Rs. 1,56,124.72 lakhs and had written back packaging incentive scheme Rs. 49,700.28 lakhs attributable to above property, plant and equipment. The net effect of these write off and write back had been disclosed under exceptional items during the quarter and year ended March 31, 2026. Also, effect of the above adjustments due to fire had been considered while assesing deferred tax as at March 31, 2026 and as at September 30, 2026. Further, claim for insurance filed by the Subsidiary Company in respect of the fire occured on 21 May 2025 and 01 January 2023 will be recognised in the books of account as and when the recognition criteria is met in accordance with Ind AS.

3 During the previous year a significant fire incident had occurred at Nashik, Maharashtra on 21st May 2025 of a subsidiary company. Post fire during the previous year, the management of the Subsidiary Company along with surveyor had done physical verification of inventory and consequently management of the Subsidiary Company had determined inventory damaged due to fire and accordingly had written off such inventory in the books of accounts as mentioned in Note no 2(b) above. However, at previous year end some areas of the said factory premises were affected and rebuilding work was in progress leading to storage space constraint and hence some of the inventories of usable waste which was not affected by fire was stored in a mixed condition for which physical verification could not be completed in its entirety as at the March 31, 2026. Subsequently, an independent third-party firm of Chartered Accountants was engaged to undertake physical verification of substantial quantum of inventories. However in respect of above-mentioned cases, quantities were determined using estimation techniques by the said third party. Pending physical verification of the inventory as at September 30, 2026, the management of the Subsidiary Company has determined the carrying amount of inventories of Rs. 27,773.65 lakhs as at September 30, 2026 as recognised it in their books of accounts.

4 As the management was in the process of assessment of losses caused due to fire, a subsidiary was continuing with accounting of depreciation on property plant and equipment damaged in fire as referred in note 2(b) and amortisation of government grant thereon recognised in other income till period ended December, 2025, but on completion of assessment, depreciation of Rs. 4,341.50 lakhs and government grant amortisation of Rs. 1,666.63 lakhs had been reversed during the quarter and year ended March 31, 2026.

5 The Subsidiary Company has availed borrowing from the Holding Company which includes an amount of Rs. 29,200 Lakhs as at September 30, 2026 on which the investor shareholder of the Subsidiary Company has raised concerns for breach of reserve matter in accordance with terms of the Shareholders’ Agreement dated 16 March 2022 executed with the investor shareholder. The Subisidiary Company and the Holding Company have received the Notice of Arbitration dated 16th October, 2026. Pending resolution of matter under Arbitration, the Subsidiary Company continues to carry such loan amount and necessary action, if any, shall be taken upon resolution of the matter.

6 The Board of Directors of the Company, at its meeting held on April 10, 2026, had considered and approved the withdrawal of the application filed under regulation 37 of SEBl(Listing obligation and disclosure requirements) Regulations, 2015 to obtain NOC from the stock exchange in respect of the proposed Scheme of Arrangement of the Company and Global Non Woven Limited ("the Scheme). The withdrawal was made in view of procedural delays, geopolitical uncertainties, evolving business and market conditions, and the significant time, cost, and regulatory processes involved in implementing the Scheme. The withdrawal has no impact on the financial position or financial performance of the Company. Consequent to the withdrawal of the proposed Scheme, the impact of the proposed demerger that was reflected in the financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2025 as discontinued operations has been reversed in the financial results for the quarter ended March 31, 2026. Accordingly, the result for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2025 has been restated.

7 During the previous year, current tax relating to earlier years includes claim filed for capital subsidy and MAT Credit entitlement and allowed by tax authorities of Rs. 1,895.69 lakhs in quarter and half year ended September 30,2025 and Rs. 2,362.75 lakhs for the year ended March 31, 2026.
8 The above consolidated results were reviewed by the Audit Committee and taken on record at the meeting of the Board of Directors at their respective meetings held on 14th November 2026 and review of these results has been carried out by the Statutory Auditors of the Company, as required under Regulation 33 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.
9 The results of the Company are available for investors at www.jindalpoly.com, www.nseindia.com and www.bseindia.com.
